annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Devices must meet general safety and performance requirements and carry CE marking after conformity assessment.
Four risk classes; notified bodies compulsory for classes IIa, IIb and III.
Manufacturers must run risk management, quality management, clinical evaluation and post-market surveillance.
Eudamed database and Unique Device Identification system for traceability and transparency.
Vigilance reporting of serious incidents, market surveillance and manufacturer financial coverage for liability.
annotation.summary_en: EU Medical Device Regulation 2017/745 sets rules for placing medical devices, including software and active implantable devices, on the EU market. It establishes risk classification, notified-body conformity assessment, CE marking, clinical evaluation, UDI/Eudamed traceability, vigilance and market surveillance. It is not AI-specific but covers actuated medical devices.
